name: After Article 26
title: REPORT on the proposal for a regulation of the European Parliament and of the Council on the Union Civil Protection Mechanism and Union support for health emergency preparedness and response, and repealing Decision No 1313/2013/EU (Union Civil Protection Mechanism)
part_text: Article 26a Information sharing and safeguards 1. Upon activation of response of the Hub in accordance with Article 26, the Member States may voluntarily provide the Hub with the information necessary to support the response to the crises 2. In carrying out the functions referred to in Article 26 and in providing support pursuant to Article 29, the Hub shall ensure the appropriate handling and sharing of information, in compliance with applicable Union law, including rules on confidentiality, data protection and the protection of sensitive and classified information. The Hub shall take all the necessary measures to ensure the confidentiality of information provided by Member States, in particular where such information relates to national security and labeled as such. 3. The Hub shall ensure the protection of trade secrets acquired in application of this Regulation in accordance with Union and national law.
